profile.headline: Software Engineer | C#. Net Developer | Practicing to integrate Claims & Finance Data Analysis Feature with Product | Data Analytics

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
●	Integrate various applications (i.e., water analysis, company website, marketing inventory, etc.) to ensure all are efficiently aligned with stakeholders’ requirements.
●	Utilize best practices in designing and implementing code that is easily understood, extensible & maintained.
●	Maintain and optimize database query performance on web app for the franchise store owner to facilitate order processing, credit card payment module for instore payment, create service, and repair.
●	Use JavaScript, Ajax, HTML5Helper as needed, while applying VSTS and Git for various project-related tasks (i.e., web portal, task board, team room, etc.)
●	Perform database modifications using SQL Server 2017 and SQL Server Manager to design store procedures

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
●	I2TE was developed for the I2TE Institute. 
●	The project's purpose was to provide end-user with the ability to see detailed information about various courses offered at the institute. 
●	Web application enabled the institute to provide updates, news, and announcements to students.
●	Web application enabled students to submit queries to Institute’s staff, enhancing and streamlining more efficient communication between campus officials and students.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: LA Sanitation
●	DevOps team member of LA Sanitation portal [LASAN] project for the city of Los Angeles
●	Portal displayed various city-wide events related to “going green”, reducing waste, and energy-saving efforts.
●	Portal also displayed and provided detailed information on three primary Public Services Programs:
o	Solid Resources Program
o	Clean Water Program
o	Watershed Protection Program
Responsibilities
●	Performed analysis while implementing related functional and technical requirements from the System Requirement Specification (SRS) for framework wiring to improve stability for the DevOps operation team
●	Developed web content using Oracle Web Center portal utilizing agile project management methodologies.
●	Utilized Oracle Remote Intra Doc Client (RIDC) technology from Oracle Content Server to develop a Search module within the portal.
o	Provided reporting results on the basis of keywords entered and displayed all relevant entries.

Project: MyLA311 (https://myla311.lacity.org/portal)
●	DevOps team member of MyLA311 project for the city of Los Angeles
●	MyLA311 is a centralized portal system used by call center agents to report and request upon 65 various non-emergency municipal services for the following six departments:
o	BOS – Bureau of Sanitation, BSS – Behavioral Street Services, ITA – Information Technology Agency
o	BSL – Bureau of Street Lighting, BOE – Bureau of Engineering, LADPW - Los Angeles Department of Public Works
Responsibilities
●	Primarily involved in the development, testing, and tuning of MyLA311 Service Request module using Oracle ADF with Java and Oracle Web Center portal
●	Developed Enterprise Level Application using MVC Architecture while forms were developed using JSP & JSF in Oracle ADF with applicable CSS.
●	Performed unit and fully functional software testing during integration.
●	Validated application integration w/ Oracle Web Center Portal, Siebel CRM & Oracle Authentication Layer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: CSP Live – Design of Level 2 Reporting System of Lime Plant
●	System developed to capture and store data in real-time from plant signal utilizing Oracle Database.
●	A designed web-based dashboard reporting tool based on digital-analog data to better understand plant production status for supervisory and analysis purposes.
